fixes.claim: Wrapping each EXCEPT in a subquery lets the final ORDER BY apply to the whole stacked result.
fixes.problem: The stated reason is wrong: in a compound SELECT the trailing ORDER BY applies to the whole compound regardless of subqueries. The subqueries are there to keep each difference self-contained rather than relying on the strict left-to-right grouping of a flat compound.
